# J. Doran Electric

J. Doran Electric is an electrical contracting business in Marina Del Rey, California.
Owner John Doran does residential and commercial electrical work.
Service area is the greater Westside of Los Angeles and the South Bay.
Services are panel replacement and upgrades, troubleshooting and repair, EV car chargers, lighting and fans, and inspections and new circuits.
Licensed, bonded, and insured in California, CSLB number 729182, since 1996.
Hours are Monday through Friday, 8 in the morning to 5 in the afternoon.
Phone is (310) 562-2849.
Email is jdoranelectric@gmail.com.
Mail address is P.O. Box 11208, Marina Del Rey, CA 90295.
To request work, call or send an email describing the address and the problem.
Website: http://www.jdoranelectric.com/
